question: Which among the following network topologies has the highest transmission speed?A) LANB) WANC) MAND) Both LAN and WAN have equal transmission speeds. (RRB NTPC Tier I (29/04/2016) Shift 2)
options: A
B
D
C
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is LAN

Explanation:
LAN (Local Area Network) spans a small geographical area such as an office or building. Due to its limited distance, data transmission experiences low latency and high speed, typically ranging from 100 Mbps to 10 Gbps. WAN (Wide Area Network) covers large geographical areas like countries or continents, and due to long distances, it has higher latency and lower speed (usually 1-100 Mbps). MAN (Metropolitan Area Network) covers a city-sized area and has speed lower than LAN but higher than WAN. Thus, LAN has the highest transmission speed among these network topologies.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the full form of LAN? → Local Area Network
☛ What is the maximum distance covered by WAN? → Unlimited (country or global)
☛ What area does MAN cover? → City or metropolitan area
☛ What type of cable is commonly used in LAN? → Ethernet cable (UTP)
☛ What is the typical speed of WAN? → 1-100 Mbps
question_hi: निम्नलिखित नेटवर्क टोपोलॉजी में से किसमें संचरण की गति सबसे अधिक होती है?A) LANB) WANC) MAND) LAN और WAN दोनों में समान संचरण गति है।  (RRB NTPC Tier I (29/04/2016) Shift 2)
options_hi: A
B
D
C
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है LAN

Explanation:
LAN (लोकल एरिया नेटवर्क) एक छोटे भौगोलिक क्षेत्र जैसे कार्यालय या भवन में फैला होता है। इसकी सीमित दूरी के कारण डेटा ट्रांसमिशन में कम विलंबता और उच्च गति होती है, जो आमतौर पर 100 Mbps से 10 Gbps तक होती है। WAN (वाइड एरिया नेटवर्क) बड़े भौगोलिक क्षेत्रों को कवर करता है, जैसे देश या महाद्वीप, और इसमें लंबी दूरी के कारण विलंबता अधिक होती है और गति कम होती है (आमतौर पर 1-100 Mbps)। MAN (मेट्रोपॉलिटन एरिया नेटवर्क) शहर के आकार का होता है और इसकी गति LAN से कम लेकिन WAN से अधिक होती है। इस प्रकार, LAN की संचरण गति सबसे अधिक होती है।

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ WAN की अधिकतम दूरी कितनी होती है? → असीमित (देश या विश्व स्तर)
☛ MAN किस क्षेत्र को कवर करता है? → शहर या महानगर
☛ LAN में प्रयुक्त केबल का प्रकार क्या है? → ईथरनेट केबल (UTP)
☛ WAN की सामान्य गति क्या है? → 1-100 Mbps

question: Full form of BIOS isA. Binary Interchange Operation SystemB. Basic Input Output SystemC. Beginner’s Input Operation SymbolD. Basic Interface Oriented service  (RRB NTPC Tier I (29/03/2016) Shift 3)
options: B
C
D
A
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Basic Input Output System

Explanation:
BIOS stands for Basic Input Output System. It is a firmware chip stored in the ROM on the computer's motherboard. When the computer starts, the BIOS first performs the Power-On Self-Test (POST), which checks the hardware's functionality. After that, it locates the boot device (like hard disk or SSD) to load the operating system. BIOS provides a low-level interface between the hardware and the OS. Modern computers have replaced it with UEFI (Unified Extensible Firmware Interface), which offers more advanced features.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Where is BIOS stored? → ROM (on motherboard)
☛ What is the initial test performed by BIOS called? → POST (Power-On Self-Test)
☛ What is the main function of BIOS? → To boot the operating system
☛ What is the full form of UEFI? → Unified Extensible Firmware Interface
☛ Which system activates first when a computer is turned on? → BIOS
question_hi: BIOS का पूर्ण रूप हैA. बाइनरी इंटरचेंज ऑपरेशन सिस्टमB. बेसिक इनपुट आउटपुट सिस्टमC. बिगिनर्स इनपुट ऑपरेशन प्रतीकD. बेसिक इंटरफेस ओरिएंटेड सर्विस (RRB NTPC Tier I (29/03/2016) Shift 3)
options_hi: B
C
D
A
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है बेसिक इनपुट आउटपुट सिस्टम

Explanation:
BIOS का पूर्ण रूप Basic Input Output System है। यह कंप्यूटर की मदरबोर्ड पर स्थित एक फर्मवेयर चिप (ROM) में स्टोर होता है। जब कंप्यूटर चालू होता है, तो BIOS सबसे पहले POST यानी Power-On Self-Test करता है, जो हार्डवेयर की कार्यक्षमता की जांच करता है। इसके बाद BIOS ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम को बूट करने के लिए बूट डिवाइस जैसे हार्ड डिस्क या SSD को ढूंढता है। BIOS हार्डवेयर और ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम के बीच लो-लेवल इंटरफेस प्रदान करता है। आधुनिक कंप्यूटरों में इसकी जगह UEFI (Unified Extensible Firmware Interface) ने ले ली है, जो अधिक उन्नत सुविधाएं देता है।

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ BIOS कहाँ स्टोर होता है? → ROM (मदरबोर्ड पर)
☛ BIOS द्वारा किया जाने वाला प्रारंभिक परीक्षण क्या कहलाता है? → POST (Power-On Self-Test)
☛ BIOS का मुख्य कार्य क्या है? → ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम को बूट करना
☛ UEFI का पूर्ण रूप क्या है? → Unified Extensible Firmware Interface
☛ कंप्यूटर चालू करने पर सबसे पहले कौन सा सिस्टम एक्टिवेट होता है? → BIOS

question: Which of the following does computing in a personal computer?A. CPUB. MotherboardC. RAMD. BIOS (RRB NTPC Tier I (29/03/2016) Shift 3)
options: B
A
D
C
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is CPU

Explanation:
In a personal computer, all computations are performed by the CPU (Central Processing Unit), which is often referred to as the brain of the computer. It is responsible for arithmetic and logical operations, data processing, and executing instructions. The Motherboard is the main circuit board that connects all components but does not perform computations itself. RAM stores temporary data for quick access by the CPU, while BIOS is the basic input/output system that helps boot the computer. Thus, only the CPU carries out actual computing tasks.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Full form of CPU → Central Processing Unit
☛ Main components of CPU → ALU, Control Unit, and Registers
☛ Which part is called the brain of computer → CPU
☛ Functions performed by CPU → Data processing, calculations, and instruction execution
☛ Unit to measure CPU speed → Hertz (GHz)
question_hi: पर्सनल कंप्यूटर में इनमें से कौन संगणना करता है?A. सीपीयूB. मदरबोर्डC. रैमD. बायोस (RRB NTPC Tier I (29/03/2016) Shift 3)

Explanation:
पर्सनल कंप्यूटर में सभी गणनाएं सीपीयू (सेंट्रल प्रोसेसिंग यूनिट) द्वारा की जाती हैं। सीपीयू को कंप्यूटर का मस्तिष्क भी कहा जाता है। यह अंकगणितीय और तार्किक संचालन, डेटा प्रोसेसिंग और निर्देशों के निष्पादन के लिए जिम्मेदार है। मदरबोर्ड एक मुख्य सर्किट बोर्ड है जो सभी घटकों को जोड़ता है, लेकिन स्वयं गणना नहीं करता। रैम अस्थायी डेटा स्टोर करता है ताकि सीपीयू तेजी से एक्सेस कर सके, जबकि बायोस बुनियादी इनपुट/आउटपुट सिस्टम है जो कंप्यूटर को बूट करने में मदद करता है। इस प्रकार, केवल सीपीयू ही वास्तविक संगणना करता है।

question: Debugging is the process ofA. Rolling out a software program.B. Modifying a software programC. Checking errors in a software program.D. Changing the design structure of a program. (RRB NTPC Tier I (29/03/2016) Shift 3)
options: C
D
B
A
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Checking errors in a software program.

Explanation:
Debugging is a crucial step in software development that involves identifying and fixing errors (bugs) in a program. This process ensures that the software works as expected. Debugging includes detecting errors, analyzing them, and removing them. It is different from modifying code, changing design, or rolling out a program. Debugging is part of quality assurance and helps make the software reliable. It is typically performed during the testing phase of the software development life cycle.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the main purpose of debugging? → To find and fix errors
☛ During which phase is debugging performed? → Testing phase
☛ What tool is commonly used in debugging? → Debugger
☛ Debugging is also known as? → Bug fixing
☛ Debugging is related to which process? → Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
question_hi: डिबगिंग की प्रक्रिया हैA. एक सॉफ्टवेयर प्रोग्राम को रोलिंग आउट करना।B. एक सॉफ्टवेयर प्रोग्राम को संशोधित करनाC. एक सॉफ्टवेयर प्रोग्राम में त्रुटियों की जाँच करना।D. एक कार्यक्रम की डिजाइन संरचना को बदलना। (RRB NTPC Tier I (29/03/2016) Shift 3)

Explanation:
डिबगिंग सॉफ्टवेयर विकास का एक महत्वपूर्ण चरण है जिसमें प्रोग्राम में मौजूद त्रुटियों (bugs) को पहचाना और ठीक किया जाता है। यह प्रक्रिया सुनिश्चित करती है कि सॉफ्टवेयर अपेक्षित रूप से कार्य करे। डिबगिंग में त्रुटियों का पता लगाना, उनका विश्लेषण करना और उन्हें दूर करना शामिल है। यह कोड को संशोधित करने, डिजाइन बदलने या प्रोग्राम को रोल आउट करने से भिन्न है। डिबगिंग गुणवत्ता आश्वासन का हिस्सा है और सॉफ्टवेयर को विश्वसनीय बनाने में मदद करती है।

question: Which key on a windows keyboard sets to full screen mode in most browsers?A. F1B. F10C. F11D. F12 (RRB NTPC Tier I (30/03/2016) Shift 3)
options: D
B
A
C
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is F11

Explanation:
In most browsers, pressing the F11 key activates full screen mode. This mode displays the webpage across the entire screen, hiding browser toolbars and other interface elements. F11 is a toggle key, meaning pressing it again exits full screen mode and returns to the normal view. This shortcut works on Windows, macOS, and Linux in almost all popular browsers (e.g., Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Opera). F1 is typically used for Help, F10 for Menu bar, and F12 for opening Developer Tools.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Full screen mode shortcut key → F11
☛ F1 key usage → Help
☛ F10 key usage → Activate menu bar
☛ F12 key usage → Open Developer Tools
☛ F11 is a toggle key → Press again to exit full screen

question: Which one of the following does not belong to the group?A. MonitorB. KeyboardC. WebcamD. Mouse (RRB NTPC Tier I (30/03/2016) Shift 3)
options: D
C
A
B
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Monitor

Explanation:
A Monitor is an output device that displays processed information from the computer. Keyboard, Webcam, and Mouse are all input devices used to provide data or commands to the computer. The Keyboard is used for typing, the Mouse for pointing, and the Webcam for capturing video. Since the Monitor outputs data while the other three input data, it does not belong to the same group. Hence, Monitor is the correct answer.

☛ What type of device is a Mouse? → Input device

question: If Bill Gates had his way, by what name was Windows OS planned to be released? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (10/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Calculator
Interface Manager
Control Panel
Clipboard Viewer
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Interface Manager

Explanation:
Bill Gates originally planned to release the Windows operating system under the name Interface Manager. However, the marketing team later suggested the name Windows, which referred to the windows that opened on the computer screen. This name was more appealing and easier for users to understand. Windows 1.0 was launched in 1985 and provided a graphical user interface (GUI) on top of MS-DOS. It helped Microsoft revolutionize personal computing. Today, Windows is the most popular operating system in the world.

question: In computer terminology, what is a nibble? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (23/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: Half a byte
A terabyte
A gigabyte
A kilobyte
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Half a byte

Explanation:
In computer terminology, the smallest unit of data is a bit. A group of 4 bits is called a nibble. Since one byte consists of 8 bits, a nibble represents half a byte. Nibbles are commonly used in hexadecimal numbering systems because 4 bits can represent values from 0 to 15, which correspond to a single hexadecimal digit. The other options, such as terabyte, gigabyte, and kilobyte, are much larger units and are not related to the concept of a nibble.

question: A/An ________ is an interface between the user and hardware. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (23/01/2021) Shift 1)

screen
memory
command
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is operating system

Explanation:
An operating system (OS) is essential software that acts as an interface between the user and the computer hardware. It manages hardware resources like CPU, memory, and storage, and allows users to run application programs. Without an OS, a computer cannot function because it controls every task, from executing commands to managing files. The OS also handles input/output operations, making it possible for peripherals like keyboard, mouse, and printer to work. Examples include Windows, Linux, and macOS. The other options—screen, memory, and command—are either hardware components or inputs, not interfaces. The screen is an output device, memory stores data, and a command is an instruction. question: Which of the following is a volatile memory? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (25/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: EPROM
RAM
ROM
PROM
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is RAM

Explanation:
Volatile memory is a type of computer memory that loses its data when the power is turned off. RAM (Random Access Memory) is a volatile memory because it retains data only while the computer is powered on. In contrast, ROM (Read-Only Memory), PROM (Programmable ROM), and EPROM (Erasable Programmable ROM) are non-volatile memories, which retain data even after power is off. RAM is used for temporary storage of data and programs currently in use by the processor. It is crucial for fast performance and high-speed data access. However, due to its volatility, data must be saved to non-volatile storage like hard drives before shutting down.

☛ Types of ROM → PROM, EPROM, EEPROM
☛ Characteristic of volatile memory → Data lost when power is off

question: Who is considered to be the Father of Modern Computers? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: James Gosling
Alan Turing
Gordon E Moore
Charles Babbage
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Alan Turing

Explanation:
Alan Turing is widely regarded as the Father of Modern Computers. He proposed the concept of the Turing Machine, which laid the theoretical foundation for modern computers. During World War II, he played a crucial role in breaking the Enigma code. Turing also contributed to the field of artificial intelligence and proposed the Turing Test. His work laid the groundwork for modern computer science, while Charles Babbage is known as the 'Father of Computers', Turing is recognized as the father of modern computing.

question: In a computer, a menu contains a list of: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/02/2021) Shift 2)

objects
commands
solution:

question: Which of the following is NOT an output device? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (02/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Printer
Speaker
Monitor
Scanner
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Scanner

Explanation:
Output devices are hardware components that receive data from a computer and present it in a human-readable form. Printer produces hard copies of digital documents, Speaker outputs audio, and Monitor displays visual information. These are all output devices. A Scanner is an input device that converts physical documents or images into digital form and sends them to the computer. It inputs data into the computer, not outputs. Therefore, Scanner is not an output device.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ What is the function of a printer? → To print digital data on paper.
☛ What type of device is a scanner? → Input device.
☛ What is a monitor used for? → To display visual output.
☛ What does a speaker output? → Audio output.
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा आउटपुट डिवाइस नहीं है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (02/02/2021) Shift 1)
options_hi: प्रिंटर
स्पीकर
मॉनिटर
स्कैनर
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है स्कैनर

Explanation:
आउटपुट डिवाइस वे उपकरण हैं जो कंप्यूटर से डेटा प्राप्त करके उसे मानव-पठनीय रूप में प्रस्तुत करते हैं। प्रिंटर डिजिटल दस्तावेज़ों को कागज़ पर छापता है, स्पीकर ऑडियो आउटपुट देता है, और मॉनिटर विज़ुअल आउटपुट प्रदर्शित करता है। ये सभी आउटपुट डिवाइस हैं। स्कैनर एक इनपुट डिवाइस है जो भौतिक दस्तावेज़ों या छवियों को डिजिटल रूप में बदलकर कंप्यूटर में भेजता है। यह डेटा को कंप्यूटर में इनपुट करता है, आउटपुट नहीं। अतः स्कैनर आउटपुट डिवाइस नहीं है।

☛ प्रिंटर का कार्य क्या है? → डिजिटल डेटा को कागज़ पर मुद्रित करना।
☛ स्कैनर किस प्रकार का डिवाइस है? → इनपुट डिवाइस।
☛ मॉनिटर का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है? → विज़ुअल आउटपुट प्रदर्शित करने के लिए।
☛ स्पीकर क्या आउटपुट देता है? → ऑडियो आउटपुट।
